semanticBoundary: The base has the legacy Explore feed but lacks the two-tab Home state holder, Home Compose surface, persisted interest model, and persistent per-module visibility store introduced by the redesign.

facts: Community and For You keep independent loading, content, error, and empty-state data.
Community age and For You batch counters advance only after successful fetches, so retry repeats failed work.
A same-day per-language For You cache is read before network generation and filters persisted hidden cards.
Language changes persist and refresh only the selected tab.
Card and module hiding has explicit restoration paths.
The screen switches between Community and For You surfaces.
Pull-to-refresh dispatches against the selected tab.
The language picker is scoped to configured app languages.
Hidden module keys are persisted as a DataStore string set and exposed as a reactive flow.
Topic and article interests have database-backed save, remove, and clear operations.
Initial failure renders a retryable error when no content exists.
Failure after partial success preserves content and appends an inline retry.
No-data and all-modules-hidden are distinct empty states with recovery actions.

coveredFacts: Home feed settings can hide all modules.
The feed becomes empty after hide-all.

externalLeaves.name: Wikimedia content services
externalLeaves.policy: Control success, empty, held, and failure responses; execute application pagination, caching, filtering, state, and retry bodies.

externalLeaves.name: analytics transport
externalLeaves.policy: Controlled sink after application-owned interaction mapping.

claimSources.claim: Two-tab Home feed, onboarding, interests, module controls, empty states, and retry behavior were introduced in the boundary.
